name: Render Free Web Services
free_limit: 750 Free web-instance hours/workspace per calendar month; unused hours do not carry over
watch_out: A Free web service spins down after 15 minutes without inbound HTTP or WebSocket traffic; waking may take about a minute. Its local filesystem is ephemeral and no persistent disk is available. Excess bandwidth/build minutes can be billed if a payment method is on file; otherwise services or builds are suspended. Not for production.
